pages.title: Flores Stegodon
pages.text: $(o)Stegodon florensis$() was a dwarf stegodon that lived on the Indonesian island of Flores during the Middle and Late Pleistocene.$(br2)Like its mainland relatives it had long, close-set tusks, but over hundreds of thousands of years it shrank from about 1.9 metres at the shoulder to only 1.3 metres.$(br2)Its bones lie alongside those of the "hobbit" $(o)Homo floresiensis$() in Liang Bua cave. It died out about 50,000 years ago.
